text:
ana: Quick follow-up from INC-2026 postmortem. We need one concise runbook page for the KV eviction recurrence: triage steps, minimal commands, and clear PD ladder. Keeping owners here.

liam: I'll own the triage checklist and write the short-commands snippet. Target: Wed EOD.

sophie: I'll own escalation and PagerDuty entries. Proposal: oncall -> infra lead -> ops lead at 20m if no recovery. Add canary rotate at 10m.

liam: Draft triage block:
```bash
# see eviction events last 15m
rictl logs svc/inference --since 15m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")'
# hit ratio short window
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual evict
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --dry-run
# commit eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --confirm
```

sophie: Add decision rule: if >70% of evictions tied to single api_key -> throttle key first (CS template) else global evict. I'll add PD escalation details.

infra-bot: [ops-bot] Playbook draft created: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/kv-evict-draft - owners: liam (triage), sophie (escalation).

ana: Timeline recap: liam PR by Wed, sophie PD entries by Tue. I'll open a GH issue to link PR + PD + postmortem. Recheck next Monday.

liam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/ops/kv-evict-playbook/pull/12 - includes commands and decision rules. Marked WIP.

sophie: PD entries drafted, requesting security review for notification messages.

ana: Thanks all. If any blocker call out here and we'll reassign. :white_check_mark:
